title: Maximum Edge Open Packing on AT-Free, Chordal, and Convex Bipartite Graphs
summary: An edge open packing is a set of edges whose endpoints induce a disjoint union of stars. We study the problem of finding a maximum edge open packing in AT-free, chordal, and convex bipartite graphs. For AT-free graphs, we use the oriented star-conflict graph $A_G$, introduced by Das and Santra, for which $ρ_e^o(G)=α(A_G)$, and prove that $A_G$ is AT-free whenever $G$ is AT-free. Consequently, a known maximum independent set algorithm for AT-free graphs yields an $O(n^2+m^4)$-time algorithm for Maximum Edge Open Packing, where $n$ and $m$ denote the numbers of vertices and edges of $G$,…
